name: shortsync
title: ShortSync
description: Create, schedule and manage ShortSync social media posts for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X and more, from Raycast and your menu bar.
author: shortsync

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: A ShortSync workspace API key (starts with ss_live_). Create one in ShortSync under Settings, API, MCP & webhooks.

preferences.name: apiBaseUrl
preferences.title: API Base URL
preferences.description: Leave as is unless you were told to change it.

commands.name: create-post
commands.title: Create Post
commands.subtitle: ShortSync
commands.description: Write a post, attach an image or video, pick your accounts and publish now or schedule it.

commands.name: scheduled-posts
commands.title: Scheduled Posts
commands.subtitle: ShortSync
commands.description: See upcoming and failed posts, publish them now, retry or cancel them.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Next Scheduled Post
commands.subtitle: ShortSync
commands.description: Show your next scheduled post and failed posts in the menu bar.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
